message: Test integrity: this change deletes a test file, removes more assertions than it adds, or adds a vacuous assertion. Fix the code under test, not the test. If the removal is deliberate (obsolete behaviour, a test moved elsewhere), a person adds 'chock: allow test-integrity' on an added line of that test file and commits from their own shell; the waiver is honoured at commit only, never in the agent (tool use, the turn's end, or a commit with CHOCK_AGENT_COMMIT set), so an agent asks a person.
